use hashbrown::HashTable;
use core::cell::Cell;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Tracked<'a> { key: u64, drops: &'a Cell<usize> }
impl Drop for Tracked<'_> {
    fn drop(&mut self) { self.drops.set(self.drops.get() + 1); }
}
fn tracked_hash(value: &Tracked<'_>) -> u64 { value.key % 4 }

fn check_drops() {
    let drops = Cell::new(0);
    let mut table = HashTable::new();
    for key in 0..129u64 { table.insert_unique(key % 4, Tracked { key, drops: &drops }, tracked_hash); }
    let mut clone = table.clone();
    table.retain(|value| value.key % 2 == 0);
    assert_eq!(drops.get(), 64);
    drop(table.find_entry(2, |value| value.key == 2).unwrap().remove().0);
    assert_eq!(drops.get(), 65);
    drop(table);
    assert_eq!(drops.get(), 129);
    {
        let mut drain = clone.drain();
        drop(drain.next().unwrap());
    }
    assert!(clone.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(drops.get(), 258);
    println!("drops {}", drops.get());
}

fn hash(value: &(u64, String)) -> u64 { value.0 % 8 }

fn main() {
    let mut table = HashTable::new();
    assert!(table.is_empty());
    for key in 0..513u64 {
        table.insert_unique(key % 8, (key, format!("v{key}")), hash);
    }
    assert_eq!(table.len(), 513);
    for key in 0..513u64 {
        assert_eq!(table.find(key % 8, |value| value.0 == key).unwrap().1, format!("v{key}"));
    }
    for key in (0..513u64).step_by(3) {
        let entry = table.find_entry(key % 8, |value| value.0 == key).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(entry.remove().0.0, key);
    }
    for key in 0..513u64 {
        assert_eq!(table.find(key % 8, |value| value.0 == key).is_some(), key % 3 != 0);
    }
    table.reserve(2048, hash);
    for key in 513..1025u64 {
        table.insert_unique(key % 8, (key, format!("v{key}")), hash);
    }
    let mut clone = table.clone();
    table.retain(|value| value.0 % 2 == 0);
    let mut digest = 0;
    for value in table.iter_mut() { value.1.push('!'); digest += value.0; }
    for value in table.iter() { assert!(value.1.ends_with('!')); }
    println!("hashbrown {} {} {}", table.len(), clone.len(), digest);
    let mut drained = 0;
    for value in clone.drain() { drained += value.0; }
    assert!(clone.is_empty());
    println!("drain {drained}");
    table.clear();
    assert!(table.is_empty());
    table.insert_unique(7, (7, String::from("again")), hash);
    println!("reuse {}", table.find(7, |value| value.0 == 7).unwrap().1);
    assert!(matches!(table.try_reserve(usize::MAX, hash), Err(hashbrown::TryReserveError::CapacityOverflow)));
    check_drops();
    let mut zst = HashTable::new();
    for _ in 0..257 { zst.insert_unique(0, (), |_| 0); }
    assert_eq!(zst.iter().count(), 257);
    assert_eq!(zst.drain().count(), 257);
    println!("zst {}", zst.len());
}
